Trouvez parmi la gamme de produits AROL la boucheuse la plus adapt\u00e9e aux bouchons et aux bouteilles que vous avez choisis pour vos jus.\n\n## Bouchons Pr\u00e9-Filet\u00e9s \u00c0 G\u00e9om\u00e9trie Irr\u00e9guli\u00e8re\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/JUICE/PRE-THREADED-IRREGULAR-GEOMETRY-CAPS-JUICE.jpg)\n\nGr\u00e2ce \u00e0 la flexibilit\u00e9 de nos machines, nous traitons tout type de bouchons \u00e0 g\u00e9om\u00e9trie irr\u00e9guli\u00e8re, de formes inhabituelles, ou surdimensionn\u00e9s.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-bouchons-pre-filetes-a-geometrie-irreguliere)\n\n## Capsule couronne en acier\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/BEVERAGE/CROWN-CORKS.jpg)\n\nLes capsules couronne sont encore largement employ\u00e9es sur les bouteilles en verre, plastique et aluminium. La boucheuse traditionnelle d\u2019AROL op\u00e8re pour les capsules couronnes de 26 et 29.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-capsule-couronne-en-acier)\n\n## Capsule couronne en aluminium\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/BEVERAGE/CROWN-CORKS-ALUMINUM.jpg)\n\nAROL propose une boucheuse adapt\u00e9e \u00e0 l\u2019application de 14 400 capsules couronnes de 26 et 29 en aluminium par heure.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-capsule-couronne-en-aluminium)\n\n## Bouchons Plats En Plastique Pr\u00e9-Filet\u00e9s\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/JUICE/PRE-THREADED-FLAT-PLASTIC-CAPS.jpg)\n\nLa machine d\u2019AROL est capable d\u2019appliquer entre 1 500 et 90 000 bouchons en plastique pour boissons, par heure.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-bouchons-plats-en-plastique-pre-filetes)\n\n## Bouchons Pr\u00e9-Filet\u00e9s En Plastique Pour Le Sport\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/JUICE/PRE-THREADED-SPORT-PLASTIC-CAPS.jpg)\n\nPour ce type de bouchon utilis\u00e9 dans divers march\u00e9s, tels que les boissons \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques et pour la sant\u00e9, l\u2019eau ou les jus, AROL propose des boucheuses \u00e0 t\u00eate unique ou multiple qui appliquent des bouchons de tailles et \u00e9paisseurs diff\u00e9rentes.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-bouchons-pre-filetes-en-plastique-pour-le-sport)\n\n## Bouchons En Plastique Pr\u00e9-Filet\u00e9s Pour Poches\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/JUICE/POUCH_03.jpg)\n\nPour tous les fabricants qui ont opt\u00e9 pour les emballages sous forme de poches pour leurs produits, AROL propose diff\u00e9rentes solutions de bouchage en fonction de leur vitesse de production et du type et de la forme de bouchon.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-bouchons-en-plastique-pre-filetes-pour-poches)\n\n## Twist Off (Couvercle \u00c0 Visser)\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/JUICE/TWIST-OFF-CAPS-A.jpg)\n\nLa boucheuse rotative d\u2019AROL est extr\u00eamement flexible : elle peut appliquer des couvercles \u00e0 visser et, si n\u00e9cessaire, \u00e9galement des capsules \u00e0 vis.\n\n[Machines](/fr/boucheuses-pour-jus/boucheuses-pour-twist-off-couvercle-a-visser)\n\n## Bouchons Ropp En Aluminium\n\nExpir\u00e9\n\n![](/caps/JUICE/SHORT-ROPP-ALUMINUM-CAPS-A.jpg)\n\nLes bouchons ROPP en aluminium peuvent \u00eatre appliqu\u00e9s sur une large vari\u00e9t\u00e9 de r\u00e9cipients, \u00e0 travers diff\u00e9rents march\u00e9s. Par exemple, des bouteilles en verre contenant de l\u2019eau min\u00e9rale ou naturelle, des boissons non alcoolis\u00e9es, du jus, de l\u2019huile comestible, des bouteilles en PET, des bouteilles en aluminium contenant des boissons non alcoolis\u00e9es, de la bi\u00e8re et du vin.\n\nQuel que soit le type de r\u00e9cipient, AROL propose une vaste gamme de boucheuses \u00e0 t\u00eate multiple ou unique pour les bouchons ROPP en aluminium.\n\nAROL fournit \u00e9galement une solution pour retirer les bouchons ROPP des bouteilles en verre et en PET caps\n\nPre-threaded sport plastic caps\n\nPre-threaded large plastic caps\n\nPress-on cover for cans\n\nShort ropp aluminum caps\n\nRopp aluminum caps\n\nPre-threaded flat plastic through blower\n- 500 litres hopper\n- secondary belt in the hopper\n- structure entirely in stainless steel\n- discharging height: 2500 mm\n- electrical board with PLC\n\n#### Options\n\n- caps bd-layoutbox-6 bd-no-margins clearfix\">\n    <div class=\"bd-container-inner\">\n        \t\n\t\t<div class=\" bd-postcontent-10 bd-tagstyles bd-custom-blockquotes bd-custom-button bd-custom-bulletlist bd-custom-orderedlist bd-custom-table bd-contentlayout-offset\" itemprop=\"articleBody\">\n    <h1>Single head capping machine</h1>\n<h4>Application</h4>\n<p>Pre-threaded irregular geometry caps<br>Pre-threaded flip top caps<br>Pre-threaded large plastic caps<br>Tethered caps</p>\n<p><strong>SPEED PRODUCTION</strong>: capsule \u2264 \u00f838: up to 33 bpm / 2.000 bph - capsule &gt; \u00f838: up to 25 bpm / 1.500 bph</p>\n \n<p><strong>CLOSURE HEADS</strong>: magnetic syncronous heads - hysteresis heads</p>\n<h4>VERSION</h4>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>STANDARD:</strong> structure with painted steel components. Not washable</li>\n<li><strong>INOX EXTERNAL SURFACES (I.E.S.):</strong> external stainless steel components. Suitable for washing of the capping zone</li>\n<li><strong>WASHABLE (UPON REQUEST):</strong> stainless steel components. complete washing of the capper is possible (thanks to gaskets and labyrinths)</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Options</h4>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>On caps chute</strong>: overturned caps automatic ejector (a.e.d.) - ionizer/dust extraction - uv lamp</li>\n<li><strong>Quick format change: </strong>sorter (manual or automatic) - caps chute - gripper - body-guide assembly (toolless std execution</li>\n<li><strong>Others: </strong>motorized height adjustment - caps elevator - additional vibrating tank - machine with motorized bottle conveyor - machine on wheels - machine in lowered execution</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Media</h4>\n<p></p><div Macchine tappatrici automatiche per bevande\n\nBevande analcoliche gassate e non gassate, bevande energetiche, bevande sportive, prodotti a base di caff\u00e8 e t\u00e8, bevande nutrizionali... Qualsiasi sia il prodotto, qualsiasi sia la dimensione della produzione, AROL offre la tappatrice adatta al vostro contenitore e alla vostra chiusura, garantendo la qualit\u00e0 e l'integrit\u00e0 del prodotto finale.\n\nLe nostre tappatrici trattano con elevata efficienza bottiglie in PET, HDPE, vetro o alluminio.\n\nLa nostra linea di prodotti comprende anche le detappatrici, per rimuovere i tappi in plastica, alluminio o corona dalle bottiglie in vetro e PET.\n\n## Cappuccio a pressione\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/./caps/BEVERAGE/OVERCAP.jpg)\n\nAROL offre tappatrici monotesta o multitesta per l'applicazione di cappucci a pressione su bottiglie in PET o in vetro.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-cappuccio-a-pressione)\n\n## Tappo in plastica pre-filettato flat\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/./caps/BEVERAGE/PRE-THREADED-FLAT-PLASTIC-CAPS.jpg)\n\nAROL gestisce tappi di plastica da 1.000 bph a 100.000 bph.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-tappo-in-plastica-pre-filettato-flat)\n\n## Tappo pre-filettato in plastica a geometria irregolare\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/./caps/BEVERAGE/PRE-THREADED-IRREGULAR-GEOMETRY-CAPS-WATER_1.jpg)\n\nGrazie alla flessibilit\u00e0 delle nostre macchine, gestiamo qualsiasi tipo di tappo con geometria irregolare, forme insolite o grandi dimensioni.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-tappo-pre-filettato-in-plastica-a-geometria-irregolare)\n\n## Tappo in plastica pre-filettato sport\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/./caps/BEVERAGE/PRE-THREADED-SPORT-PLASTIC-CAPS-01B.jpg)\n\nPer questo tipo di tappi, utilizzati, ad esempio, per bevande energetiche, l\u2019acqua o i succhi di frutta, AROL offre tappatrici multitesta e monotesta che applicano tappi di varie dimensioni e spessori.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-tappo-in-plastica-pre-filettato-sport)\n\n## Coperchio a pressione per lattine\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/./caps/BEVERAGE/PRESS-ON-COVER-FOR-CANS-2.jpg)\n\nAROL fornisce tappatrici a una o pi\u00f9 teste per l\u2019applicazione a pressione del tappo o del coperchio su lattine di varie dimensioni.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-coperchio-a-pressione-per-lattine)\n\n## Ring pull\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/./caps/BEVERAGE/RING-PULL-C.jpg)\n\nQuesto tipo di chiusura \u00e8 tipicamente utilizzato su bottiglie di vetro, alluminio e plastica che contengono birra e/o bevande energetiche. AROL, tra le altre, fornisce una macchina dedicata che gestisce sia le chiusure ring pull sia corona.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-tappo-ring-pull)\n\n## Tappo in alluminio ropp\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/caps/WINESPIRITS/SHORT-ROPP-ALUMINUM-CAPS-A.jpg)\n\nI tappi in alluminio ROPP possono essere applicati a una grande variet\u00e0 di contenitori in diversi mercati. Ad esempio, bottiglie di vetro riempite con acque minerali e naturali, bibite, succhi di frutta, olio alimentare, bottiglie in PET, bottiglie in alluminio riempite con bibite, birra e vino.\n\nIndipendentemente dal tipo di contenitore, AROL dispone della pi\u00f9 ampia gamma di tappatrici multitesta o monotesta per tappi in alluminio ROPP.\n\nAROL offre anche una soluzione per la rimozione del tappo ROPP da bottiglie di vetro e bottiglie ref-PET.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-tappo-in-alluminio-ropp)\n\n## Tappo corona in acqua, birra o vino: per questo tappo AROL propone una capsulatrice adatta all'applicazione sia di tappi da 26 \u00d8 che da 29 \u00d8 fino a 60.000 bph.\n\n[Macchine](/it/macchine-tappatrici-per-bevande/tappatrici-per-tappo-corona-in-acciaio)\n\n## Tappo a corona in alluminio\n\nScaduto\n\n![](/caps/BEVERAGE/CROWN-CORKS-ALUMINUM.jpg)\n\nAROL fornisce una capsulatrice adatta a trattare tappi a corona in alluminio da 26 \u00d8 e da 29 \u00d8, con una capacit\u00e0 fino a 14.400 E P.IVA 03217610967 \n \n \n \n3 \n \nINTRODUCTION \nArol S.p.A. (the \u201cCompany\u201d), in the conduct of its business, makes reference  to \nethical principles  derived  from  a  legacy  of  individual  and  corporate  values, \nconsolidated over time. These values, which shall serve as the foundations for the \nconduct of all those who, at various levels of responsibility, by their acts, contribute \nto the performance of the overall activities of the Company, including consultants \nand any other external collaborators, are mainly: \n \n\u2022 Moral integrity, personal honesty, and fairness in internal and  external \nrelations. \n\u2022 Transparency towards shareholders, interested parties and the  market  in \ngeneral. \n\u2022 Respect for employees and a commitment to enhance their  professional \nskills. \n\u2022 Health, safety, and environmental protection. \n\u2022 Social commitment. \nMore generally, the Company does not accept any conduct which, even \nthough it is aimed at achieving an outcome consistent with its own interest, shows \naspects which are not compatible with an organizational and operational \nmodel characterized by the absolute observance of the law and rules of conduct \nand procedures that apply within the Company.  \nThis  Code  of  Ethics  integrates  and  complements  the  rules  of  conduct  already \ndefined, or in the process of being defined, by the Company for specific activities \nor categories of subjects, including: \n \n\u2022 The organizational and operational model. \n\u2022 The provisions on handling sensitive and confidential information. \n\u2022 The  provisions  for  reducing  or minimizing possible  risks  of  an accident  at \nwork,  of  which  employees  were  made  adequately  aware  of,  and  which \nshall be consulted for in-depth treatment of specific topics. \n\u2022 The environmental provisions. \n\nCODE OF ETHICS \nFeb. 2024 \nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. All   employees   have   the \nright/obligation to know and apply it, request explanations when in doubt, report \nany shortcomings or the need to update and amend it. \nIn particular, the management of the Company is required to apply the Code of \nEthics in all activities, projects and investments proposed and carried out, keeping \nit in mind even when establishing the company\u2019s objectives and implementing the \nnecessary information activities for its members of the staff. It is also disseminated \namong  all  third  parties  with  whom the  Company maintains  a  relationship  in  the \ncourse  of  its  business  activities,  including  through  the  publication  on  its  website, \nwww.arol.com, as  well  as  by  any  other  means  of  communication  that  proves \nnecessary to this end. \nThe employees, in relation to their specific skills, shall: \n \n\u2022 Inform  third  parties  about  the  contents  of  the  Code  of  Ethics  and, in \nparticular, of the obligations arising from it which the employees of the \nCompany have. \n\u2022 \nEnsure  that  third  parties  meet  the  requirements  of  the  Code  of  Ethics \nrelating to their relationship with the Company. \n\u2022 Report,   through   the   whistleblowing   procedure   published   on   the \nCompany's  website,  any  breach  by  third  parties  of  their  obligation  to \ncomply with the provisions of the Code of Ethics, as stated above. The Supervisory Board shall \npromote  the  necessary  activities  for  the  dissemination,  training  and \nupdating of the Code of Ethics as well as raising awareness on it within \nthe Company. \n\nCODE OF ETHICS \nFeb. 2024 \n \nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. This  commitment  shall  also  apply  to \nconsultants, managers, any special proxies, and anyone acting in the name and \non behalf of the Company. \nNo  form  of  gift  exceeding  normal  commercial  practice  or  courtesy  or  aimed  at \nobtaining preferential treatment is allowed. \nGifts or preferential treatment to Italian or foreign public officials and their \nrelatives, which may affect their independent judgment or lead to any \nadvantage, are forbidden. \n \nGifts to, and acts of courtesy and hospitality towards government representatives, \npublic officials, and civil servants, are allowed when they are of modest value and, \nin any case, when they: \n \n\u2022 Do not compromise the integrity or reputation of one of the parties. \n\u2022 Cannot  be interpreted, by  an  impartial  observer, as being  aimed at \nobtaining advantages improperly. \n\u2022 Do  not  influence  the  decision-making  autonomy,  independence  of \njudgment and impartiality of the counterparty. Even in countries where \nit is customary to offer gifts to clients or to other parties out of courtesy, \nthese shall be of an appropriate nature and shall not breach the law. \nThey  shall  not,  however,  be  such  as  to  be  construed  as  a  request  for \npreferential treatment. Those who receive forbidden donations, gifts or \nbenefits are required to notify the Supervisory Board which, according \nto  the  established  procedures,  shall  assess  their  appropriateness  and \ninform  the  third  party about the Company\u2019s policy  on  the  matter.  The \nprovisions  of  the  Code  of  Ethics,  in  relation  to  donations,  gifts  and \nbenefits, apart from applying, without exception, to directors, managers \nand  employees,  must  also  be  complied  with  by  all  those  working \ntogether for the achievement of the objectives of the Company. \n\nCODE OF ETHICS \nFeb. 2024 \n \nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. (the \u201cCompany\u201d), in the conduct of its business, makes reference to\nethical principles derived from a legacy of individual and corporate values,\nconsolidated over time. These values, which shall serve as the foundations for the\nconduct of all those who, at various levels of responsibility, by their acts, contribute\nto the performance of the overall activities of the Company, including consultants\nand any other external collaborators, are mainly:\n\n\u2022 Moral integrity, personal honesty, and fairness in internal and external\nrelations.\n\u2022 Transparency towards shareholders, interested parties and the market in\ngeneral.\n\u2022 Respect for employees and a commitment to enhance their professional\nskills.\n\u2022 Health, safety, and environmental protection.\n\u2022 Social commitment.\nMore generally, the Company does not accept any conduct which, even\nthough it is aimed at achieving an outcome consistent with its own interest, shows\naspects which are not compatible with an organizational and operational\nmodel characterized by the absolute observance of the law and rules of conduct\nand procedures that apply within the Company.\nThis Code of Ethics integrates and complements the rules of conduct already\ndefined, or in the process of being defined, by the Company for specific activities\nor categories of subjects, including:\n\n\u2022 The organizational and operational model.\n\u2022 The provisions on handling sensitive and confidential information.\n\u2022 The provisions for reducing or minimizing possible risks of an accident at\nwork, of which employees were made adequately aware of, and which\nshall be consulted for in-depth treatment of specific topics.\n\u2022 The environmental provisions.\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. All employees have the\nright/obligation to know and apply it, request explanations when in doubt, report\nany shortcomings or the need to update and amend it.\nIn particular, the management of the Company is required to apply the Code of\nEthics in all activities, projects and investments proposed and carried out, keeping\nit in mind even when establishing the company\u2019s objectives and implementing the\nnecessary information activities for its members of the staff. It is also disseminated\namong all third parties with whom the Company maintains a relationship in the\ncourse of its business activities, including through the publication on its website,\nwww.arol.com, as well as by any other means of communication that proves\nnecessary to this end.\nThe employees, in relation to their specific skills, shall:\n\n\u2022 Inform third parties about the contents of the Code of Ethics and, in\nparticular, of the obligations arising from it which the employees of the\nCompany have.\n\u2022\nEnsure that third parties meet the requirements of the Code of Ethics\nrelating to their relationship with the Company.\n\u2022 Report, through the whistleblowing procedure published on the\nCompany's website, any breach by third parties of their obligation to\ncomply with the provisions of the Code of Ethics, as stated above. The Supervisory Board shall\npromote the necessary activities for the dissemination, training and\nupdating of the Code of Ethics as well as raising awareness on it within\nthe Company.\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. The Company, therefore, pays particular attention to the promotion,\nprotection and development of the skills and competencies of all its employees so\nthat they can maximize their potential and professionalism.\nFor this purpose, the Company, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations\nand Company policies in force, and through the relevant departments,\nundertakes to:\n\n\u2022 Select, hire, compensate, train, and assess employees based on merit,\ncompetence, and professionalism, without any discrimination on\ngrounds of politics, trade union affiliation, religion, race, language, or\ngender.\n\u2022 Guarantee a working environment in which relationships between\ncolleagues are defined by loyalty, cooperation, mutual respect, and\ntrust.\n\u2022 Offer adequate working conditions from a safety, health, and hygiene\nperspective, which are also respectful of everyone\u2019s moral personality,\nin a way which enhances interpersonal relationships without any bias.\n\u2022 Intervene in case of attitudes that do not comply with the above\nprinciples.\n\u2022 Fight, in particular, any form of sexual harassment, intimidation, hostility,\nisolation, undue interference, or conditioning.\nFor the purpose of implementing the above, the Company undertakes to make its\nHuman Resources operational policies available through the existing internal\ncommunication channels.\nEach head of department is required to involve his/her members of the staff in\ncarrying out the tasks and in achieving the assigned objectives. In turn, the latter\nshall participate with dedication, precision, and professionalism, contributing\neffectively and efficiently to carry out the activities established.\nThrough training, the Company has always promoted professionalism within the\ncompany, by means of growth and development programs.\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. This commitment shall also apply to\nconsultants, managers, any special proxies, and anyone acting in the name and\non behalf of the Company.\nNo form of gift exceeding normal commercial practice or courtesy or aimed at\nobtaining preferential treatment is allowed.\nGifts or preferential treatment to Italian or foreign public officials and their\nrelatives, which may affect their independent judgment or lead to any\nadvantage, are forbidden.\n\nGifts to, and acts of courtesy and hospitality towards government representatives,\npublic officials, and civil servants, are allowed when they are of modest value and,\nin any case, when they:\n\n\u2022 Do not compromise the integrity or reputation of one of the parties.\n\u2022 Cannot be interpreted, by an impartial observer, as being aimed at\nobtaining advantages improperly.\n\u2022 Do not influence the decision-making autonomy, independence of\njudgment and impartiality of the counterparty. Even in countries where\nit is customary to offer gifts to clients or to other parties out of courtesy,\nthese shall be of an appropriate nature and shall not breach the law.\nThey shall not, however, be such as to be construed as a request for\npreferential treatment. Those who receive forbidden donations, gifts or\nbenefits are required to notify the Supervisory Board which, according\nto the established procedures, shall assess their appropriateness and\ninform the third party about the Company\u2019s policy on the matter. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n11\n\nRELATIONSHIPS WITH SUPPLIERS\nIn their relationships with suppliers, employees shall:\n\n\u2022 Closely follow the established internal procedures for the selection,\nqualification, and award of supply contracts and acceptance of products\nor services, documenting in a clear and transparent way the assessment\ncriteria, in order to ensure the maximum competitive advantage for the\nCompany and ensuring compliance with the best quality level of products\noffered to the Company.\n\u2022 Not arbitrarily exclude from tenders or general requests for supplies from\npotential suppliers who meet the requirements for tenders or other supply\ncontracts.\n\u2022 Enforce and comply with the established contractual conditions.\n\u2022 Avoid resorting to suppliers to whom they are related by consanguinity or\naffinity.\n\u2022 Take all possible precautions to avoid having recourse to suppliers who are\nnot themselves inspired by the same ethical principles as those of the\nCompany.\nBy reason of the foregoing, the Company shall regularly review its list of suppliers\nin order to rationalize it and increase cost-effectiveness and efficiency.\nTo ensure maximum transparency, the Company shall organize itself in a way that\nensures:\n\n\u2022 The separation of roles between the departments requiring the supply and\nthose stipulating the contract, subject to the exceptions already provided\nfor by corporate procedures.\n\u2022 Adequate ability to reconstruct and trace decisions taken.\n\u2022 Preservation of documents in accordance with the regulations in force and\ninternal procedures.\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n12\n\nUSE AND PROTECTION OF CORPORATE ASSETS\nAll employees and members of the staff shall remember that the company\u2019s\ntangible and intangible assets that the Company places at their disposal are to be\nused:\n\n\u2022 Appropriately and with the utmost care, to avoid damage or injury.\n\u2022 Avoiding, as far as possible, waste, tampering or any use that could\njeopardise their efficiency or could lead to their rapid deterioration.\n\u2022 Exclusively for purposes related to, and fundamental for, the working\nactivity.\n\u2022 While completely avoiding the use or sale of the assets by or to third\nparties, even temporarily, except as provided by specific legislation.\nAll employees and members of the staff shall be responsible for the use and\nsafekeeping of assets given to them by the Company.\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n13\n\nUSE AND DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION\nThe Company shall envisage the dissemination of correct, complete, and truthful\ninformation about all corporate events, and maintaining the required\nconfidentiality on them, as a basis to create and maintain a relationship defined\nby transparency and trust with interested parties and the market in general.\nConsequently, when handling information, employees shall:\n\n\u2022 carefully retain, in the strictest confidence, all types of corporate\ninformation learned while performing their duties (employees\u2019 personal\ndata, organisational data, data concerning negotiations, financial\noperations, know-how, patents, chemical formulas, market plans, strategies\nand analysis).\n\u2022 Ask for consent for the processing of personal data, for the purposes\ncommunicated.\nIn relation to general information, employees shall:\n\n\u2022 Avoid misusing confidential information in their possession or using it for their\npersonal advantage and/or to the advantage of their relatives,\nacquaintances or any third parties.\n\u2022 Protect it from being accessed by unauthorized third parties and prevent it\nfrom being disseminated.\n\u2022 Not seek or attempt to obtain information from others that is not related to\ntheir area of competence or function.\n\u2022 Classify and organize it in a way that allows authorised parties to access it\neasily and get a complete picture.\nEmployees who are not expressly authorised may not get to know, record, process\nand disclose personal data about other employees or third parties.\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n14\n\nTRANSPARENCY IN ACCOUNTING\nIn bookkeeping and accounting records, the principle of truth, accuracy, clarity,\nand completeness of the information shall be completely observed.\nConsequently, employees shall:\n\n\u2022 Give business facts in a complete, transparent, truthful, accurate and\ntimely manner, in order to facilitate all of the accounting process, in\naccordance with the established procedures.\n\u2022 Record properly and without any omission every economic and\nfinancial transaction.\n\u2022 Keep adequate records of every transaction, so as to facilitate the\nverification/reconstruction of the decision-making and authorisation\nprocess, the latter according to the appropriate levels of responsibility.\n\u2022 File such documentation in a logically organised manner, so that it can\nbe easily found.\n\u2022 Allow checks indicating the nature and reason for the transaction.\n\u2022 Provide the auditors and other controlling bodies, even internal ones,\nwith the necessary information in a truthful and complete manner.\nThe Company\u2019s employees who learn directly of any omissions, forgeries or\nnegligence regarding accounting or documentation on which the accounting\nrecords are based, are required to report the facts to the Supervisory Board.\nReporting these facts may not expose the employee to sanctions of any kind.\n\n\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n15\n\nHEALTH, SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION\nThe Company is convinced that having its activities fully compatible with the\nterritory and the surrounding environment is a primary condition for the\nacceptance of its facilities and its operational commitment and for the\nachievement of its development goals. The Company is therefore constantly\ncommitted so that the various companies operate while promoting their\nemployees\u2019 health and that of third parties, their safety, as well as being\nenvironmentally friendly, in the broadest sense of the term.\nIn particular, thanks to the active contribution of its employees, the Company shall:\n\n\u2022 Promote and implement all reasonable initiatives aimed at minimising the\nrisks and removing the causes that could jeopardise the employees\u2019 health\nand safety, as well as those of the persons who are in the areas where its\nfacilities are located.\n\u2022 Ensure that attention is paid, and that there is an ongoing commitment, to\nimprove its environmental performance through the reduction of air, water\nand soil emissions, and a responsible and conscious use of natural resources.\n\u2022 Assess beforehand the environmental impacts of all new activities,\nprocesses, and products.\n\u2022 Develop a constructive cooperation relationship, based on maximum\ntransparency and trust, both internally and with the external community\nand institutions in the management of health, safety, and environmental\nissues.\n\u2022 Maintain high levels of safety and environmental protection through the\nimplementation of effective management systems.\n\u2022 Continuously disseminate information, create awareness, and provide\ntargeted training, aware that to achieve the objectives set out above, the\nactive contribution of all employees is decisive.\nIn compliance with the above principles, the Company has imposed a ban on\nsmoking in all workplaces, outside of specific ventilated booths.\nAs a sign of the great importance that the Company attaches to protecting of the\nvalues of health, safety and environment, the assessment of the employees\u2019\nindividual performances takes into account whether or not their conduct is\nconsistent with the Company's policies and, in particular, with the above-\nmentioned values.\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\n\n16\n\n\nFor its part, the Company adopts an organisational and operational model that\nensures a business system for the fulfilment of all legal obligations relating to:\n\n\u2022 The respect of the technical and structural standards of the law\nconcerning equipment, facilities, workplaces, chemical, physical, and\nbiological agents.\n\u2022 Risk assessment activities and preparation of consequent prevention\nand protection measures.\n\u2022 Activities of an organisational nature, such as emergencies, first aid,\nmanagement of contracts, periodic safety meetings, consultations with\nworkers\u2019 safety representatives.\n\u2022 Health surveillance activities.\n\u2022 Information activities and workers\u2019 training activities.\n\u2022 Monitoring activities related to workers\u2019 compliance with safety\nprocedures and instructions at work.\n\u2022 The acquisition of documents and certificates required by law.\n\u2022 Periodic checks of the implementation and effectiveness of the\nprocedures adopted.\n\n\n\n\n\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n17\n\nRELATIONSHIPS WITH OTHER ENTITIES\nEven when dealing with parties with whom it does not have any kind of contractual\nrelationship, the Company considers that respecting all the principles and values\ncontained in the Code of Ethics shall be a priority.\nIn particular, relationships with public institutions for the protection of the\nCompany\u2019s interests within these institutions shall be managed by the competent\ndepartments or by those that have been delegated such a role.\nThe Company fully and strictly complies with antitrust rules and with those set by\nAuthorities regulating the market.\nFurthermore, the Company does not deny, hide, or delay any information\nrequested by these organisations and actively cooperates during preliminary\ninvestigations.\nShould the Company, in the sphere of relations with public institutions, wish to make\nuse of third-party consultants or representatives, the latter shall behave as laid\ndown in the Code of Ethics.\nThe Company allocates contributions, whether direct or indirect, in any form, to\npolitical parties, movements, committees or organisations or those related to trade\nunions, their representatives or candidates, only as laid down in the specific\nregulations in force.\n\nEmployees shall not make or promise donations to be paid by the Company, or in\nthe latter\u2019s interest.\nOnly the department in charge of dealing with the media does so, in order to ensure\nconsistency of communication.\nThese departments have a role to play based on the messages of the top\nmanagement with regard to general policy and image activities of the Company and\nof the competent operational departments with regard to specific subjects.\nEmployees cooperate as necessary with the departments in charge of dealing with\nthe media so that true, accurate and transparent information is provided to the\noutside world.\nEmployees called upon to provide or disclose information to the outside world\nregarding objectives, activities, results, and points of view of the Company shall\nobtain prior authorisation from the top management of the organisation as regards\nthe contents/opinions to be communicated and these shall be agreed upon by\nthe department in charge of dealing with the media.\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\n\n18\n\nRELATIONS WITH THE AUDITING COMPANY\n\nAuditors (if any) must be guaranteed free and full access to the data, documents,\nand information they need to perform their activities.\n\nIn order to ensure the utmost respect for their independence and impartiality, the\nCompany undertakes to:\n\n\u2022 not to confer appointments that are incompatible with auditing.\n\u2022 not to confer assignments for activities that may result in impairing the\nindependence and objectivity of the auditors. Those who have taken\npart in the audit of the Company's financial statements with\nmanagement and supervisory capacities, business partners, directors\nof the audit firm to which the audit engagement has been assigned\nand of the companies controlled by it or controlling it may not hold\ncorporate offices in the management and control bodies of the\nCompany and the companies controlled by it or controlling it, nor may\nthey perform self-employed or salaried work in favour of the same\ncompanies, unless at least three years have already elapsed (i) since\nthe expiry or withdrawal of the engagement, i.e. (ii) from the moment\nin which they ceased to be partners, directors or employees of the\naudit firm and of the companies controlled by it or controlling it.\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\n\n\n19\n\nTAX TRANSPARENCY AND COMPLIANCE\n\nThe Company implements tax management activities aimed at minimizing the risk\nof operating in violation of tax regulations and condemns any form of tax evasion.\nIt pursues the objective of preventing tax disputes, behaving with transparency\ntowards the tax authorities of the countries in which it operates.\n\nAll employees work to ensure that tax returns offer as complete and truthful a\nrepresentation of the Company as possible and are committed to complying with\nsector regulations.\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nAROL S.p.A. \u2013 Viale Italia, 193 - 14053 CANELLI (ASTI) ITALIA - C.F. E P.IVA 03217610967\n\nCODE OF ETHICS\nFeb. 2024\n\n\n20\n\n\nANTI-MONEY LAUNDERING\n\nThe Company hinders and prevents the use of its finances and its economic-\nfinancial system for the purposes of money laundering, self-laundering and/or\nterrorist financing (like any other criminally relevant activity).\n\nThe Company acts in such a way that the activity in which it participates does not\nfavour, even just potentially, the receipt, replacement or reuse of money, goods\nand/or other benefits deriving from illicit activities. Preferring the use of systems\nother than cash, in the execution and collection of payments.\n\nFurthermore, the Company abstains from operations that may prevent or not allow\ncorrect identification of the origin of the money, goods, and other utilities. Before\nestablishing economic relationships, the Company verifies with the utmost\ndiligence the information available on commercial counterparties, suppliers,\npartners, and consultants, to ascertain the correctness of their activity.\n\nThe Company avoids relationships with individuals who are reasonably believed to\nbe involved in criminal activities of any kind, or whose professional credibility\nand/or reliability cannot be verified.", "metadata": {"url": "https://www.arol.com/images/pdf/CODE-OF-ETHICS_1.2_EN.pdf", "sourceURL":
